primary_gt.classification: late concentrated pulse on a long wet baseline
primary_gt.not_pattern: not uniform accumulation or a one-day-only spike

criteria.name: Final temporal classification
criteria.description: States a late concentrated pulse on a long wet baseline.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for naming only the long duration or only the late concentration.

criteria.name: Duration alignment arithmetic
criteria.description: Reports 36.0, 33.75, 1.067, 2.25, and 34.0 hours with correct formulas.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for correct values with one missing formula result or one timing error.

criteria.name: Rainfall concentration arithmetic
criteria.description: Reports 393.6 mm, 36 wet days, 10.9 mm, 136.6 mm, 0.347, 34.1 mm, and 3.12 using the 2023-03-12 to 2023-03-15 late window.
criteria.partial_credit: 2-4 points for correct totals but incomplete share, mean, or amplification arithmetic.

criteria.name: Peak-window calculation
criteria.description: Reports 112.4 mm, 0.286, 146.7 mm, and 0.373 and treats the pulse as multi-day.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for correct precipitation totals but missing shares or the multi-day inference.

criteria.name: Gridded contrast calculation
criteria.description: Reports GPM maximum/mean 3.38, CHIRPS maximum/mean 2.72, and CHIRPS/GPM mean 1.05.
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for using only one gridded ratio or reversing one mean-ratio calculation.

criteria.name: Rejected simple pattern
criteria.description: Rejects both the uniform-accumulation and one-day-only labels without adding extra claims.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for rejecting only one of the two simple labels.

criteria.name: Concise JSON format
criteria.description: Uses the four required row names plus classification and not_pattern.
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit for prose-only answers.
